extracted.intended_audience: people searching or researching MacArthur Foundation grants (grantseekers, researchers, journalists, general public)
extracted.subtask_description: Using the MacArthur Foundation's online Grant Search interface to find grants and impact investments by selecting filters (location, amount, year, program area, keyword) and sorting results. The page documents the searchable fields, filter options, and sorting behavior for the grants database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable fields / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Search grants since 1978 by keyword, year, program area, amount, and region of impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which metadata dimensions are supported for searching the grants database (keyword, year range, program area, amount, region/location).

rubrics_metrics.name: Location (country / region)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A large list of countries and territories is provided to filter grants by country of impact; includes 'All States' as an entry that leads to U.S. state selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. State filter
rubrics_metrics.description: All States — [list of U.S. states and District of Columbia].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows filtering grants limited to a U.S. state (full state list provided). Appears as a secondary location selector when 'All States' (or similar) is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount (funding size buckets)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predefined funding-size ranges to filter grants by award amount. 'Any' returns all amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year (from / to range)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selectable start and end year to restrict grants to a time range; the available year choices span 1978 through 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: All Grants and Impact Investments (type)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter to include grants and/or impact investments. The label indicates the dataset includes both traditional grants and impact investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sorting options
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort — Most Recent; Most Relevant; Grantee Name (A-Z).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls presentation order of search results: chronological (Most Recent), relevance-based (Most Relevant), or alphabetical by grantee name. No scoring details provided for 'Most Relevant'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filters UI controls
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UI includes controls to apply multiple filters and to clear all filters; facilitates iterative narrowing or broadening of search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data publication lag notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: After the Foundation's approval of a grant, there may be a delay before it appears on our website while the grant agreement is finalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises users that search results may not immediately reflect very recent approvals due to administrative publication delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellows Search referral
rubrics_metrics.description: Please visit the Fellows Search for information about MacArthur Fellowship recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides users seeking information about MacArthur Fellows to a separate specialized search tool, implying the Grant Search does not include Fellowship recipient data.
